notes.title: Grimm's Hollow: Pocket Goods finally out on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35984913/2f45818a9a6dca07ffdef653fa08818a119186fa.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1183640/Grimms_Hollow_Pocket_Goods/][h1][b]Check out Pocket Goods here.[/b][/h1][/url]
Hello! The artbook that I mentioned [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1170880/view/3040472934142415079]previously[/url] can now be purchased on Steam. 

When you purchase it, you'll find the artbook in the game's directory folder. To access it, right click on [i]Grimm's Hollow [/i]in your Library tab, select[i] Properties[/i] and click [i]Browse Local Files[/i]. The fan pack will be in the folder called Pocket Goods. [i](These instructions are also on the Steam page). [/i]

To those of you shared the game with others, or sent me kind messages about how you enjoyed it, reviewed it, drew fanart, etc., I want to let you know that it meant so much that someone thought the game was worth something. It gave me some confidence in what I do that wasn't there before. To those who[url=https://natbird.bandcamp.com/album/grimms-hollow-ost] also supported the OST[/url], thank you so much. 

Anyways, uh, that's enough from me. I hope you find the fan pack enjoyable! 

Thanks for reading,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35984913/a329bacb792930601a73b9d0ced00e910284474a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Official artbook for Grimm's Hollow is available early!
notes.content:
[url=https://ghosthum.itch.io/grimms-hollow-pocket-goods][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35984913/ac4980d088d36a43b131b731e16eee326c72876d.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://ghosthum.itch.io/grimms-hollow-pocket-goods][h1][b]Check out the artbook here. 
[/b][/h1][/url]
Thank you everyone for your support for [i]Grimm's Hollow![/i] If you enjoyed the experience, you can now check out a fan pack called [i]Pocket Goods. [/i] Inside the pack is a digital artbook, wallpapers for mobile and desktop, and commentary about the game's development. 

It's already available on the [url=https://ghosthum.itch.io/grimms-hollow-pocket-goods]developer's itch.io page[/url], but if not it will also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1183640/Grimms_Hollow_Pocket_Goods/]release on Steam in the middle of June.[/url]

Thanks for your time!

notes.title: Grimm's Hollow - Update V 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35984913/41e2b5dec366997bc4d5f0edb79cb3ee53391bd5.gif[/img]

Thank you to everyone who messaged me and sent an email regarding the game's bugs. Here's a breakdown of the first update:

[b][h3]New content:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]"Casual" mode: [/b]after hearing feedback that some players wanted to experience the story, but found the combat very difficult or wanted to spend less time in combat, I included a mode that lowered the amount of fights and made progression easier in the game to make the game's world more accessible. 
[*] You can get a[b] baguette. [/b]
[/list]

[b][h3]Significant changes:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]A previously inaccessible ghost wall can now be entered. [/b]
[*] Some fights have been made easier. 
[*] You gain a tiny bit of Spirit Energy when you pass out. [i](This was to avoid players accidentally soft locking themselves out of winning a battle). [/i]
[/list]

[b][h3]Bug fixes:[/h3][/b]
[list] 
[*][b] The speed glitch that resets your speed to 1 is fixed.[/b] To players who have encountered this, replaying the last boss battle should put your speed back to normal. 
[*] There are no more infinite muffins. (To make up for this loss, there is now a stack of muffins hidden somewhere). 
[*] Minor collision errors. 
[*] Accidental repeated cut scenes with Grimm and Baker are gone. 
[*] You can no longer open up the menu during some cutscenes. 
[*] Swinging is now slightly more accurate.
[*] It was previously possible to encounter an error where the defence stat could never be maxed out. 
[/list]

There are somethings which I am struggling to fix and therefore haven't been changed - for example, the evasion bar still unfortunately sometimes overlaps with the player selecting a command. 

If you find any other errors in the newest update (that haven't been mentioned in the forums), please do make a new topic or message me by email on grimmshollowgame@gmail.com and I'll note it down. 

Thank you to everyone for the positive feedback, and thank you for taking the time to read this. I hope you all enjoy your Christmas holidays, and see you next decade. 

[i]- ghosthunter [/i]

[i]P.S: An OST release is in the works. :) 
[/i]
